maudit.any_flip_monthly.spec: fraction of M4 Monthly series where the argmin winner is not the same model across all 5 scoring metrics (MASE/RMSSE/sMAPE/RMSE/MAE)

maudit.any_flip_weekly.spec: fraction of M4 Weekly series where the argmin winner is not the same model across all 5 scoring metrics (MASE/RMSSE/sMAPE/RMSE/MAE)

maudit.flip_mase_rmsse_monthly.spec: fraction of M4 Monthly series (5 standard forecasters: snaive/naive/ar1/ets/theta) whose argmin winner differs between MASE and RMSSE scoring

maudit.flip_mase_rmsse_weekly.spec: fraction of M4 Weekly series (5 standard forecasters: snaive/naive/ar1/ets/theta) whose argmin winner differs between MASE and RMSSE scoring

maudit.mean_distinct_monthly.spec: mean number of distinct argmin winners per M4 Monthly series across the 5 scoring metrics (MASE/RMSSE/sMAPE/RMSE/MAE), 5 standard forecasters (snaive/naive/ar1/ets/theta)

maudit.mean_distinct_weekly.spec: mean number of distinct argmin winners per M4 Weekly series across the 5 scoring metrics (MASE/RMSSE/sMAPE/RMSE/MAE), 5 standard forecasters (snaive/naive/ar1/ets/theta)
